conventions: Public interfaces live in root package glowflow; default adapters live in defaults package.
Tests are package-local Go tests using direct struct literals and t.Fatalf assertions.
Implementation should preserve current misspelled state.storeage filenames unless explicitly renamed.
Use TDD: add failing RedisStorage tests before editing production adapter code.

hard: Do not implement code during planning phase.
Use apply_patch for later file edits.
Do not revert unrelated user or formatter changes.
Do not change StateStorage interface unless execution discovers a hard mismatch.
Do not wire StateStorage into Engine dispatch in this Redis adapter plan.
soft: Keep implementation contained to defaults/state.storeage.redis.go and focused tests where possible.
Prefer deterministic list semantics so tests do not depend on Redis scan order.
Run go mod tidy only if dependencies change.
compatibility: NewRedisStorage currently accepts *redis.Client and returns glowflow.StateStorage.
Missing states should preserve errors.Is compatibility with glowflow.ErrStateNotFound.
security_requirements: Do not log Redis credentials or connection URLs in tests or errors.

patterns: Root package defines interfaces, options, engine, compiler, dispatcher, and state models.
defaults package currently contains adapter skeletons rather than engine-integrated behavior.
StateStorage is unused by Engine today; Redis adapter can be tested through the interface directly.

key_components.name: StateStorage contract
responsibility: Declare InstanceState, NodeState, filters, statuses, ErrStateNotFound.
Require CRUD/list methods for instance and node runtime state.

key_components.name: Engine options
responsibility: Does not currently drive persistence behavior.

purpose: Only current Redis storage implementation surface.
Contains redisStorage with *redis.Client field and NewRedisStorage constructor.
Confirms go 1.26 and go-redis/v9 v9.21.0 are already present.
Will record any test helper dependency if added.
Shows WithStateStorage only stores the adapter on options.
Confirms engine integration is outside current Redis adapter scope.
Confirms Engine does not currently call StateStorage during Dispatch, Load, or Reload.
Prevents accidental expansion into runtime persistence wiring.

gotchas.text: There is no existing in-memory StateStorage implementation to mirror.
Redis SCAN/order is not deterministic; tests should define stable list order independent of raw scan order.
State structs contain any fields; JSON round trip may decode numbers/maps with standard encoding/json shapes.
Engine stateStorage option is present but unused; wiring it would expand scope beyond completing Redis adapter.

prior_decisions.decision: Plan Redis adapter as standalone StateStorage implementation.
rationale: Engine currently does not call StateStorage, so adapter contract is the narrow implementation boundary.

prior_decisions.decision: Use TDD with RedisStorage contract tests before production code.
rationale: User explicitly requested TDD in task context.
List filtering and missing-state behavior need tests to prevent ambiguous implementation.

prior_decisions.decision: Avoid renaming state.storeage files in this plan.
rationale: Filename typo is existing repository shape.
Renaming would add churn unrelated to completing Redis storage behavior.
